propositions: Activated project criteria never enter code-review Round A/B because the runner iterates only the static req.criteria and the gate YAML injects only built-in overlays.
Findings cannot be attributed to project.<name> because they are stamped with physical reviewer_id and lack a logical criterion id.
A Round-A-only project_criteria input is added to CodeReviewBatchRunner so LLM-tier project criteria execute exactly once and never in Round B, without mutable seen-set state.
Project entries carry both physical prompt and logical criterion_id; emitted findings preserve model-emitted tags and append the logical id once while keeping physical reviewer_id provenance.

A missing or malformed project criterion prompt must fail loudly with a located LLMError naming the logical criterion and expected prompt path, and criteria_routing.json errors must not degrade to built-ins.
An overlay-absent repo must produce unchanged ordered built-in Round-A/Round-B requests and findings.
